subject: Security portal: timebox & authority checklist for CAIQ/SIG upload
messages:
From: Sally Park <sally.park@intech.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: InTech Security Team <security@intech.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ/SIG upload — timebox + cert chain question

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the call last week. We're starting the vendor portal intake for InTech Systems and I want to confirm a small set of checks before we open the upload window on our OneTrust tenant: 

- Can you confirm the retention TTL you expect for evidence uploaded to OneTrust (we typically ask for a >90-day availability for ephemeral proofs)?
- Do you have a canonical owner who will be responsible for the CAIQ/SIG mapping and the SOC 2 attestation upload?
- We need a certificate chain (PEM) and signing authority for the SOC 2 letter — is that something you can provide as a single artifact or will it be staged via presigned S3?

We plan to open the portal on Aug 10 and close the initial intake on Aug 17. If you can't make that window, let me know an alternate window and who on your side will do the upload.

Attached: InTech intake template (for reference).

Best,
Sally Park
Vendor Security Program Manager
InTech Systems

--
Attachment stub: InTech_Intake_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sally Park <sally.park@intech.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG upload — timebox + cert chain question

Marissa / Rishi / Naomi — looping you in. Sally wants a quick confirmation on TTL, owner, and whether we provide cert chain directly or via presign. We do have a 90-day ephemeral proof flow in Vendr but the SOC2 PDF is a permanent artifact. Can one of you confirm:

- Owner for upload (OneTrust vs Vendr) + who will be the signer for the attestation
- Whether we will provide the full PEM chain (preferred) or hand a presign S3 flow (acceptable)
- If we can commit to the Aug 10–17 intake window (short notice but doable if owner is assigned)

I'm happy to send the external note once we have answers.

Thanks — Lukas
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 12:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG upload — timebox + cert chain question

Quick answers from an operations perspective: 

- Upload owner: Marissa (I will coordinate the OneTrust/Vendr handoff). I can upload CAIQ/SIG mapping and the SOC2 PDF to Vendr, then link into OneTrust if they prefer.
- Attestation signature: Legal signs the SOC 2 attestation; I'll attach the signed PDF (soc2-attestation-2026.pdf).
- Cert chain: We can provide the PEM bundle. For pipelines where InTech needs presign instead, I can generate a one-time presign link (S3) and include presign-upload-instructions.md in the handoff.
- TTL: We typically set ephemeral proof TTL to 90 days for presigned artifacts; canonical evidence (SOC2, CAIQ) will be retained in Vendr indefinitely per our retention policy.

Aug 10–17 intake: I can own the window if we confirm Legal will sign by Aug 9 (I will nudge them). If Legal needs more time we should propose Aug 12–19.

Marissa Cole
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: soc2-attestation-2026.pdf (signed attestation), presign-upload-instructions.md (text)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG upload — timebox + cert chain question

Adding a few technical notes for the intake: 

- CAIQ mapping: I'll attach the CAIQ_mapping_20270808.xlsx (sheet includes question -> control mapping + references to our SOC2 sections). Use that for the initial OneTrust QnA import.
- PEM chain: we'll provide two files: full_chain.pem and public_only.pem. Full chain will be uploaded to Vendr (access-controlled). If InTech requires direct upload into OneTrust, we can provide the public_only.pem via presign.
- Metadata: please ensure the upload includes the following metadata tags so our retention automation can run: vendor:onboarding=intech, ttl:ephemeral=90d (if presign), evidence:type=attestation/caiaq.

I'll prepare the presign links if Marissa wants them.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stubs: CAIQ_mapping_20270808.xlsx, full_chain.pem

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sally Park <sally.park@redwoodintech.com>, InTech Security Team <security@intech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ/SIG upload — timebox + cert chain question

Hi Sally — thanks for the heads up. Short plan and commitments below: 

1) Intake window: Aug 10–17 — confirmed. Marissa will own uploads and will be the point of contact for any content questions.
2) Owner: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com) will do the OneTrust/Vendr handoff; Legal will sign and provide the official SOC 2 PDF by EOD Aug 9.
3) Artifacts: Attached we are sending: CAIQ_mapping_20270808.xlsx (control mapping), soc2-attestation-2026.pdf (signed), and presign-upload-instructions.md. If you need the PEM full chain directly, we will share public_only.pem via presign; full_chain.pem will remain in Vendr behind RBAC.
4) TTL/Retention: For presigned uploads we set ttl:ephemeral=90d. Canonical artifacts (SOC2, CAIQ mapping) are retained per our policy; we will add vendor:onboarding=intech metadata so your automation can pick it up.

Next steps for you: confirm OneTrust wants direct CAIQ import vs a linked Vendr attachment; if direct import, reply and we'll provide the presign links before EOD Aug 10.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments included: CAIQ_mapping_20270808.xlsx, soc2-attestation-2026.pdf, presign-upload-instructions.md
